Off-peak a kind reminder for passengers

With that in mind

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers with companion animals should check their documents, carrier setup, and boarding steps before heading to the airport. That helps keep the trip smooth for you and your pet, and it gives the team a clear path to help if plans change.

If your travel is affected by a problem in transit, please speak with the desk as soon as you can. <<FACT F120>> The passenger coordinator will guide you through the needed steps, and the senior coordinator reviews any case that needs a calm follow-up. If a departure runs late, the team will also explain the standard support available and how it is handled. <<FACT F109>> We aim to keep things steady, simple, and fair for every traveler and every pet.

If you need help with forms, carrier checks, or day-of travel questions, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
